analysis.reasonEn: RSI slightly rose from 57.7 to 59.1 but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram held at -0.5756 without improvement or deterioration, signaling no trend reversal. Volume ratio at 0.26 of 5-day average indicates subdued activity. The current price of $532.88, 3.7% off its 52-week high and at 89.8% of its range, remains in a bullish zone. However, the absence of clear buy/sell signals warrants a wait-and-see approach.
